families.processor: 16 kHz mono waveform; one caller-owned normalization; float32 input_values
families.tokenizer: fixed audited CTC vocabulary; blank/repeated-token collapse
families.backends: DeploySharp ONNX Runtime CPU and OpenVINO CPU FP32 IR
families.evidence: Official predictor, Python ORT/OpenVINO, DeploySharp ORT/OpenVINO, OpenCV input factory, and NuGet-only consumer agree on CTC transcript.

families.blocker: The local opset-17 three-graph export, C# tokenizer, prompt construction, managed WAV log-Mel preparation, and greedy session pass parity on a licensed LibriSpeech fixture. The source-only profile has no executable graph bindings, and a traceable downloadable three-graph bundle is still required for public catalog admission.
The source checkpoint is audited, but no downstream task head or complete portable graph contract was acquired.
The gated pipeline requires authenticated access and contains multiple component models; no authorized complete portable bundle or redistribution grant was available.

ownership: AudioUnderstandingSession owns backend sessions, one immutable profile, and request-local state. The caller owns the registry, tokenizer, processor, prepared audio, VAD segmentation, and speaker metadata. Results own transcript, CTC frame spans, diagnostics, and timing.
publication: External metadata only. uploaded=false, downloadable=false, redistributionAllowed=false. Local execution does not upgrade AlgorithmVerified or authorize a Release asset.
